description: Phase-4 fresh holdout target headwords. Headword selection is frozen before sense resolution and before any candidate/model output is inspected.

policy.group_balance: 5 targets in each of 4 writer-oriented groups
policy.overlap_policy: No headword may overlap the original frozen 50-target writer-relevance set.
policy.selection_policy: Targets are selected before Phase-4 candidate export and must not be replaced based on V2.5, learned, neural, or hybrid ranking quality.
policy.sense_policy: Sense IDs must be resolved only against the frozen V1 lexical artifact and reviewed before candidate export.
policy.candidate_policy: Candidates are exported from V2.5 only. Writer reranker output must not be used to choose or replace holdout targets.
